# SnapRender

Give your Antigravity agent eyes on the web. SnapRender renders public web
pages in a real browser, so the agent can see a page the way a visitor does
(desktop, phone, full page, dark theme) and read it as clean markdown before
it writes code. Works with Google Antigravity: the App, the IDE and the CLI.

## What you get

- **Hosted MCP server** at `https://app.snap-render.com/mcp` with 11 tools:

  | Tool | What it does |
  | --- | --- |
  | `take_screenshot` | Capture a page as PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF, on desktop or a phone, tablet or laptop preset, one screen or the full page |
  | `extract_content` | Read a page as markdown, text, HTML, article, links or metadata |
  | `batch_screenshots` | Capture up to 50 URLs in one background job |
  | `get_batch_status` | Check a batch job and get its download links |
  | `check_screenshot_cache` | See whether a free cached copy exists, without capturing |
  | `get_usage` | Captures used and left this month, and the reset date |
  | `sign_screenshot_url` | Make a signed link that renders a screenshot when opened |
  | `list_webhooks`, `create_webhook`, `delete_webhook`, `test_webhook` | Manage webhook notifications |

- **Skills**
  - `/check-page-visually`: screenshots a page on desktop and on a phone and
    reports layout problems (cut-off text, overlaps, broken navigation,
    unreadable text, missing images).
  - `/read-web-page`: reads a page as markdown, trimmed to the main content,
    so the agent works from the current docs instead of memory.

Ads and cookie banners are removed from captures by default.

## Install

**From the Antigravity Marketplace:** in the Antigravity App, open
Customizations, then Marketplace, find SnapRender and click Add. In the CLI,
run `/plugin` and use the Discover tab.

**From GitHub:**

```sh
agy plugin install https://github.com/User0856/snaprender-antigravity-plugin
```

**From a local folder:**

```sh
agy plugin install ./snaprender-antigravity-plugin
```

## Sign in

The plugin uses OAuth, so there is no API key to paste. The first time the
SnapRender server connects, Antigravity opens your browser. Sign in to
SnapRender (or create a free account) and click Allow.

If Antigravity asks for an authorization code: open Customizations, then
Installed, find SnapRender under MCP Servers and click Authenticate. Finish
the sign-in in the browser, copy the code it shows, paste it into "Enter
authorization code" and click Submit. The server reconnects by itself and
tokens refresh automatically.

In the CLI: run `/plugin`, expand SnapRender under Installed and choose
Sign in.

Prefer an API key? Skip the plugin and add the server to your own
`mcp_config.json` with an `Authorization: Bearer <API key>` header. The setup
page below has the snippet. Keys are in your dashboard at
https://app.snap-render.com/dashboard.

## Try it

- Screenshot https://example.com on desktop and on iPhone 15 Pro and list what
  looks broken on mobile
- Read https://example.com/docs as markdown and summarize the API it documents
  before we write code
- How many SnapRender captures do I have left this month?

More ideas: capture our preview deployment in dark mode, take a full-page
screenshot of a landing page as a PDF, or batch-capture every URL in a
sitemap list.

## Good to know

- **Public pages only.** SnapRender cannot reach localhost, private networks
  or pages behind a login. Use a public or preview deployment URL.
- **Firewall checks.** If a capture of your own site shows a security check
  such as "Just a moment...", one firewall rule lets SnapRender through:
  https://snap-render.com/docs/allow-snaprender
- **Approvals.** Antigravity asks before each MCP tool call until you allow
  the server's tools in your permission settings.

## Pricing

The free plan includes 200 captures a month (25 until you verify your email),
no card needed. Each screenshot or extraction uses one capture, failed
renders are free, and `get_usage` and the cache check cost nothing. Paid
plans: https://snap-render.com/pricing

## Privacy

SnapRender only sees the URLs and options the agent sends when it asks for a
capture. It does not read your code, files or workspace. Captures are
returned in the tool result and cached for a limited time so repeat requests
can be served free; cached copies are deleted automatically when the cache
expires. Full policy: https://snap-render.com/privacy

## Links

- Antigravity setup guide: https://snap-render.com/ai-connectors/antigravity
- Product: https://snap-render.com
- Terms: https://snap-render.com/terms

## License

MIT
